test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( s0 LowCardinality(String), s1 LowCardinality(String), s2 LowCardinality(String), s3 LowCardinality(String), u0 LowCardinality(UInt64), u1 LowCardinality(UInt64), u2 LowCardinality(UInt64), u3 LowCardinality(UInt64) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.query: SELECT l.number, r.s0, r.s1, r.s2, r.s3, r.u0, r.u1, r.u2, r.u3 FROM numbers(50000000) AS l ANY LEFT JOIN tab AS r ON 1 FORMAT Null
